sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Neo4j：圖遍歷、最短路徑與循環
related.titleEn: Neo4j: graph traversal,shortest paths and cycles
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：區分寫入確認、可被搜尋與持久化，建立可見性時間線。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Distinguish write acknowledgement,search visibility and durability in a timeline. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用 BFS 找最少邊數路徑，說明它不自動等於最小權重路徑。
related.differenceEn: Use BFS for minimum-edge paths and distinguish them from minimum-weight paths.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Refresh 使新 segment 可搜尋，與 flush/durable recovery 邊界不同；即時 GET 與 search 可能不同。 教學基準：3.0-2.2 = 0.8 modeled visibility delay seconds；第二檢核：1/0.1 = 10 refresh frequency multiplier if 0.1 s。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
無權圖 BFS 依層擴展；有非等權重時需要其他策略，visited 能避免循環反覆擴展。 教學基準：1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D；第二檢核：1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Refresh makes new segments searchable and differs from flush/recovery durability; real-time GET and search may differ. Teaching baseline: 3.0-2.2 = 0.8 modeled visibility delay seconds; second check: 1/0.1 = 10 refresh frequency multiplier if 0.1 s. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

BFS expands unweighted layers; unequal weights need a different strategy and visited sets prevent cyclic re-expansion. Teaching baseline: 1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D; second check: 1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 區分資料檔存在與已提交snapshot可見，追蹤失敗提交留下的孤兒檔。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish existing data files from committed-snapshot visibility and trace orphan files after failed commits.
